Weapon Kills grant 15% improved <special/>Special ammo generation and 10% improved <heavy/>Heavy ammo generation from all sources for #e${5+#d} seconds. Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration up to 7 seconds.

Buff is additive to Ammo Finder Helmet mods.
